card.name: Partway through dose and drug names
card.fires_on: Single characters or short pieces in the middle of numbers, radiation units, and drug names. Typical cases are the 'y' in mGy/MBq, a digit inside a decimal, and 'me' in omeprazole.

modes.label: Gray units and dose numbers
modes.description: The 'y' of Gy/mGy or a digit within a number in radiation dosimetry tables.
modes.example: Absorbed dose per unit activity (G<<y>>/GBq) N = 2

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: A middle piece of a long drug name, such as gadobutrol or omeprazole.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of radiation dose units, numbers and long drug names, before the word is finished.
